text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Is the Wakagoma Stakes finally about to 
begin...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Never thought I'd be competing against 
Teio in a race so soon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Taking on a challenge, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe I should bet on the downtown 
spirit sleeping inside me—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Isn't it kinda noisy outside—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaah~, we're heeere! Made it in time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh... Why are you here...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's Nature-ee! Feels like it's been 
a while, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So why are you in my waiting room, 
exactly?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! You just wanted to chat with 
me, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this is my waiting room! It even 
says so right on the door!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's true. It says "Nice Nature" on 
it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... you just took years off my 
life.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry! I guess I just got a little 
too excited!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because my Teio Road is finally about to 
begin!♪"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win by a mile today! Because the 
big, roaring cheers are waiting just for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorry, sorry! Did I overstay my 
welcome?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's both do our best today! See 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ... Quite the roar of the crowd, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, asking if I got rattled? Thanks for 
your concern.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm totally fine. I mean, Teio's 
always like that, so—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――The protagonist only looks forward. It's 
only natural... not to care about the mobs 
around them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To have something so glaringly obvious 
driven home to me now, of all times...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... Aww, man!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really get all this stuff 
about 'taking on challenges,' though."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――Perhaps I should go pay my respects to 
our protagonist.
